recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, minimalist interior scene featuring a man seated at a kitchen table in a sparse room. The environment is defined by a black-and-white checkered floor, a vintage white stove, and a chrome toaster. The man is focused on a single lit match, creating a warm focal point against a cool, desaturated background.
coreVisualRelationships: The warm glow of the match vs. the cool blue-gray walls
The geometric grid of the floor vs. the organic form of the seated figure
The high-positioned text vs. the low-centered subject
The vertical line of the clock cord vs. the horizontal plane of the table
coreInvariants: Black and white checkered linoleum floor
Single point light source from the match flame
Desaturated color palette with high tonal contrast

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered horizontally, occupying the middle third of the frame, seated behind a gray laminate table.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The lit match flame serves as the primary visual anchor and light source for the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top text, drops to the subject's face, follows his gaze to the match, and then radiates out to the surrounding kitchen elements.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive flat wall space above the subject creates a sense of emptiness and isolation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cool gray and off-white (walls and appliances)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm orange/yellow (match flame and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the floor tiles and the bright white stove.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Extremely wide tracking between all characters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both artist name and title, distinguished by slight color shifts.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment across the top edge

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the square, wide, and clean 80s aesthetic.
Provides the necessary horizontal expansion and technical feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A man with brown hair in a white button-down shirt sits at a gray kitchen table in a sparse room. He is looking down at a lit match in his hand. The floor is black and white checkered tile. To the left is a vintage white stove. To the right is a chrome toaster. A red wall clock hangs high on the right wall. Lighting is dramatic, coming from the match flame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place uppercase geometric sans-serif text across the very top of the image. Use extreme letter spacing. Apply a subtle vertical gradient to the letters and a thin dark outline.

verificationChecks: Is the floor a clear black and white checkerboard?
Is the text tracking wide enough to span the width of the image?
Is the match flame the primary light source for the face?
Is the composition centered and balanced?

adjustableVariables: Wall color (from cool blue to neutral gray)
Amount of grain/noise in the photo
postGenerationChecks: Check for correct checkered floor perspective
Ensure the toaster reflection looks metallic
Verify the text is perfectly horizontal
Confirm the match flame is not overly blown out
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a solitary figure in a minimalist retro environment with high-contrast lighting and ultra-wide tracked geometric typography at the top margin.
